$comment: Smoke config: cheap settings for checking the harness with tasks/00-smoke. Not for real runs.

claude.$effortComment: Passed as --effort. Must be set explicitly (for example "high"); never left to the CLI default.

codex.$modelComment: Candidates on this machine: gpt-6.1-sol, gpt-6.1-terra. Must be set explicitly.
codex.$effortComment: Passed as -c model_reasoning_effort=<effort>. Must be set explicitly.
codex.$disableFeaturesComment: Isolation: keeps the account's ChatGPT apps/connectors, remote plugins, memories and browser/computer use out of the run. Claude Code gets no browser either.

limits.$budgetComment: Per-run cost cap in USD. Claude Code enforces it with --max-budget-usd; for Codex the runner computes cost from the live rollout token records and kills the run when it is exceeded.
limits.$timeoutComment: Per-run wall-clock timeout for the agent process.

pricing.$comment: USD per 1M tokens, used only for Codex (Claude Code reports its own total_cost_usd). Standard tier from https://developers.openai.com/api/docs/pricing, read 2026-11-15. input_tokens include cached tokens; output_tokens include reasoning tokens. Requests whose input exceeds longContextThreshold are priced at the long-context rates. Re-check before a real run.

$isolationComment: docker (preferred): the agent runs in ui-sdk-bench-agent:local with only its workspace and an isolated home mounted. host: the agent runs directly with an isolated HOME / CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR / CODEX_HOME, but can still read the rest of the filesystem.

auth.$comment: copy-credentials: copy ~/.claude/.credentials.json and ~/.codex/auth.json into each run's isolated home, and copy a refreshed token back afterwards if the original is unchanged. env: pass through the variables listed in passEnv instead (for example ANTHROPIC_API_KEY, OPENAI_API_KEY).

$workRootComment: Where agent workspaces live during a run (default: <os tmpdir>/ui-sdk-bench-work). Kept outside the repo so the hidden tests are never next to a workspace.
